FX-STRIPE-001.says: The settings as they start: completion 0, so nothing changes.

FX-STRIPE-003.says: Thickness 3, completion 40: four lines across the drawing, each wiped from the left, the top one furthest along.

FX-STRIPE-004.says: Thickness 3, slant 0, completion 40: the top line done, the second part way, the others not started.

FX-STRIPE-005.says: Thickness 3, slant 99, completion 40: all four lines together, a straight edge.

FX-STRIPE-006.says: FX-STRIPE-003 flipped: the lines wiped from the right.

FX-STRIPE-007.says: Direction 90, thickness 4, completion 40: the lines are columns, wiped downward.

FX-STRIPE-008.says: Direction 30, thickness 3, completion 50: the lines turned.

FX-STRIPE-009.says: Thickness 1, completion 50: ten one-pixel lines, a staircase edge.

FX-STRIPE-010.says: Thickness 20 (as added), completion 60: one line, a straight wipe.

FX-STRIPE-011.says: Completion keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear, thickness 3: frame 2 is completion 50, frame 4 all clear.

FX-STRIPE-012.says: Thickness keyed from 2 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4, linear, completion 50: frame 2 is thickness 4.

FX-STRIPE-013.says: FX-STRIPE-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-STRIPE-015.says: Completion 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-016.says: Completion -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-017.says: Direction 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-018.says: Thickness 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-019.says: Thickness 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-020.says: Slant -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-021.says: Slant 100, above 99. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-022.says: Flip "yes": it is "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-023.says: Flip "On": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-STRIPE-024.says: Slant keyed to 120 at frame 4: a key outside the range. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
